description: A Gemini client's countTokens request whose history ends with a model turn is sent as it is (no trailing user turn), to Vertex AI with a service account.

exceptions.reason: The new core sends a Gemini client's countTokens body to the upstream as the client wrote it; today's core adds the model's name to the body (the model is already in the path).
The new core gives a Gemini client the upstream's countTokens reply as it came; today's core rebuilds it from totalTokens alone, with a promptTokensDetails entry of modality TEXT it makes up.
